section.1: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah

1.name_native: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah

hadiths.text: Ibn 'Abbas narrated that his maternal aunt Maimunah said:"I brought a piece of cloth (for drying) to the Messenger of Allahwhen he performed a bath to cleanse himself from sexual impurity. He refused it and began to shake off water
